definition.simple: A weight hanging from a string that swings back and forth, like in an old grandfather clock.
definition.academic: A simple pendulum consists of a small metallic ball or a piece of stone suspended from a rigid stand by a thread.

examples: A child swinging on a playground swing

common_misconceptions: Believing the mass of the bob changes the time period of the pendulum.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: 'If I pull the pendulum higher, will it take more time to swing back?' (It actually takes the same time for small angles).
